findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/config.ts:623 — duplicate-key protection only checks keys when path is exactly promptEnvelope.roles. JSON containing duplicate top-level promptEnvelope objects or duplicate roles members is accepted and JSON.parse silently selects the last contradictory role flag; a reviewed legacy-full-context value can therefore become full-envelope (or vice versa). Repro after build: assertNoDuplicatePromptEnvelopeRoleKeys accepts both {promptEnvelope: legacy, promptEnvelope: full} and {promptEnvelope:{roles: legacy, roles: full}}, while JSON.parse resolves full. Reject duplicate promptEnvelope and promptEnvelope.roles container keys as well as duplicate individual role keys, with regression coverage for all nesting forms.

concept-cleanup: legacy-full-context rollback is not exact for supported full-asset hosts. packages/main/src/core/prompt-role-contract-registry.ts:144-149 deliberately forces source=package-registry in legacy mode and therefore does not bind or validate the actual .claude/.lattice-codex full asset, while those physical assets now contain the modular role body. packages/main/src/handlers/review-run.ts:330 only appends the reconstructed legacy body as an EXACT LEGACY REVIEW PROMPT after the host has already loaded the modular full-asset prompt. The resulting model input is modular+legacy, not the frozen pre-migration prompt, yet runtime:prompt_role_body_rollout_gate and docs claim a byte-exact rollback/selected host identity. Either make full-asset launch use a thin mode-aware bootstrap so only the resolver-selected body reaches the model, or explicitly bind both actual host bootstrap bytes and injected body and stop claiming exact legacy rollback. [HIGH]
